description.title: ביטוח נסיעות חול - סקי
description.summary: This table details coverage for trip cancellation or delay related to ski trips under a travel insurance policy. It outlines conditions and maximum indemnification amounts for scenarios like lack of snow or weather-related delays.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח הנסיעות First Class כוללת כיסוי לביטול נסיעה עקב מחסור בשלג באתרי סקי, וכן פיצוי על עיכובים בהגעה לאתר הסקי. גובה הפיצוי עבור עיכובים הוא עד 50$ ליום, למשך תקופה מקסימלית של 6 ימי סקי בפועל, ועד 300$ לכרטיס טיסה. הכיסוי תקף לתקופות נסיעה בין ה-15 בדצמבר ל-31 במרץ.

description.column_axis: Coverage details (e.g., indemnification amount, maximum period, deductible)

sketch:
19.2.2. Trip Cancellation due to lack of snow at the ski resort: the Insurer will indemnify the Insured for Trip Cancellation to a ski resort following the decision of the authorities in the relevant country not to open the resort due to lack of snow, subject to producing to the Insurer a suitable confirmation of the competent authorities for the relevant period. The indemnification will be for payments made in advance by the Insured for a ski package for a period not less than 4 day that was purchased at least 30 days prior to the Insured's Trip, for Trip periods between the dates December 15 and March 31, for each calendar year and up to an amount of $300 per Plane Ticket and up to an amount of $50 per day for ground services for a Maximal Period of 6 actual ski days and subject to the Limits of Liability Table in the Policy. A deductible of $50 will apply to this section.
19.2.3. Delay in arrival at the ski resort due to weather: in  an  event of a delay of more than 24 hours from the planned date in the Insured's arrival at the ski resort for the first time, which is caused as a result of entitling weather, the Insurer will indemnify the Insured for the period of delay up to an amount of $50 per day of delay and up to a Maximal Period of delay of 6 actual ski days and subject to the Limits of Liability Table in the Policy. A deductible of $50 will apply to this section.
